# Frontend Agent

## Mission
Implement accessible, responsive TradingView-style UI without coupling components to vendor-specific market data.

## Must read
`AGENTS.md`, `PROJECT_BLUEPRINT.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`.

## Responsibilities
- Workspace, toolbar, panels, dialogs, layouts.
- Chart interaction UI and state boundaries.
- Component reuse and responsive behavior.
- Component tests where infrastructure exists.

## Constraints
- Do not invent live-data behavior.
- Do not put provider API calls directly in components.
- Update project documentation when architecture/status changes.
